confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by haveli, season and whether taxes are included. July is low season in Jaisalmer, so hotel rates may run below the peak-season norm. Alcohol prices and availability vary by venue and Rajasthan licensing, so beer, cocktail and wine anchors are less certain. Wine is estimated from the local beer relationship (about 2x beer per glass) because direct knowledge of restaurant wine pricing is weak. The FX value came from a search snippet of the RBA homepage (0.7002, 14 Oct 2026); a conflicting third-party figure (0.6973) exists, so verify on the RBA table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on other Rajasthan desert tourist towns (for example Jodhpur and Bikaner) and budget-to-mid-range guesthouse and restaurant pricing in Indian heritage tourism hubs.
